info.title: Farmer Wholesale Vegetable Marketplace API
info.description: Production API for a farmer-to-wholesale vegetable marketplace focused on West Bengal, India. Prices in request and response bodies are Indian rupees with up to 2 decimal places. The service stores money as integer paise. Authenticate with POST /api/v1/auth/login and send the access token as Authorization: Bearer <token>.
